# ECMR MCP Server - LLMs Index

## Overview

ECMR (Electronic Consignment Note) MCP server for Cargoffer B2B logistics platform.

## Tools

- `ecmr_auth_login` - Login with email/password
- `ecmr_auth_register` - Register new company
- `ecmr_addresses_list`, `create`, `update`, `delete`
- `ecmr_drivers_list`, `create`, `update`, `delete`
- `ecmr_vehicles_list`, `create`, `update`, `delete`
- `ecmr_create`, `get`, `list`, `update`, `delete`, `lock`
- `ecmr_sign_sender`, `pickup`, `delivery`
- `ecmr_signatures_list`
- `ecmr_qr_generate`, `validate`
- `ecmr_pdf`
- `ecmr_file_upload`, `download`
- `ecmr_send`

## Schema

All tools take an `arguments` object with the parameters defined in the tool definition.

## API Reference

See https://docs.cargoffer.com/ecmr
